series: Climate Fiscal Policy Briefs · Section 3: Finance and Risk · October 2026
title: Make Clean Power an Asset Class

slides.title: Make Clean Power an Asset Class
slides.subtitle: Standardized de-risking for developing countries: section 3 in ten slides
slides.message: Clean power is cheap to build and dear to finance. Remove payment risk at its source with a payment intermediary, then turn projects into a few standard securities. The state's exposure becomes smaller, contingent and contracted.
slides.author: Stephen J. Stretton · writing in a personal capacity
